primary.title: REITs vs REIT mutual funds vs physical property: A complete guide to capital gains tax, TDS and post-tax returns
primary.summary: The same real estate exposure can result in different post-tax returns. REIT mutual funds and listed REITs offer a shorter holding period for long-term capital gains than direct property, while differences in income taxation and TDS can further impact investor returns.

related.title: No international mutual funds left for fresh SIPs after Baroda BNP Paribas Aqua FoF closure: What investors can do now?
related.summary: Indian investors no longer have any international mutual fund open for fresh SIPs after Baroda BNP Paribas Aqua FoF stopped accepting new investments. With overseas investment limits restricting fund houses, investors are left with alternatives like international ETFs or direct overseas investing.
